title: Image Tag
body: `` — embeds an image. It's a void element, so there's no closing tag. ```html ``` `src` is the [[URL]] of the image file, and it triggers a separate [[HTTP]] request — the browser fetches the HTML first, then requests each image it finds. `alt` is the text shown if the image fails to load and the text a screen reader announces, so it isn't optional in any page that cares about accessibility. Setting `width` and `height` matters for performance: without them the browser doesn't know how much space to reserve, so the page jumps around as images arrive (a [[Reflow]] each time). See [[HTML]].
